draft.title: Variables and controlled experiments
card: the one factor the experimenter deliberately changes, such as the temperature of a reaction mixture.
the factor that is measured to see the effect, such as the time taken for a reaction to finish. It may change because of the independent variable.
all other factors that could affect the result, such as concentration and volume. They are kept the same in every trial.
If only the independent variable changes, any change in the dependent variable can be linked to it. This is how a controlled experiment shows cause and effect.
draft.remember: Change one thing, measure the result, and keep everything else the same.

a.q: A student heats the same acid at different temperatures and times how long a piece of magnesium ribbon takes to dissolve. What is the dependent variable?
opts: The time taken for the magnesium to dissolve
The mass of the magnesium ribbon
a.why: The dependent variable is what is measured to see the effect, which is the dissolving time. The temperature is tempting, but the student deliberately changes it, so it is the independent variable.
a.clue: Which quantity is measured as the outcome, not set by the student?

b.q: Liam tests how the concentration of hydrochloric acid affects the rate of gas production from marble chips. He uses large chips in the weakest acid and powdered chips in the strongest acid. Why can he not conclude that concentration caused the change in rate?
opts: Chip size also changed, so it was not controlled
Gas production is not a suitable dependent variable
He changed concentration, which is the dependent variable
He used more than one concentration of acid
b.why: Chip size changed along with concentration, so a difference in rate could come from either. Only the independent variable should change, with other factors controlled. Using several concentrations is needed to test the effect, so it is not a flaw.
b.clue: Count how many factors differ between the trials.

a.best: The time taken for the magnesium to dissolve

b.best: Chip size also changed, so it was not controlled
